headline: Each Anthropic co-founder would sell just shy of $250 million in the IPO
body: Anthropic disclosed in its new S-1 filing that each of its seven co-founders will sell 3,378,378 shares. At the midrange of $74, each founder would take in just shy of $250 million. Collectively, the founders will control 51.1% of the votes.
note: The control figure is the one to read: the founders will control 51.1% of the votes, and each also receives Class F stock with supervoting rights.

evidence.text: As Anthropic barrels toward an enormous IPO that could value it at $1.4 trillion, the company has disclosed a tidbit in its new S-1 filing about how many shares each of its seven co-founders plan to sell.
At the midrange of $74, each founder would take in just shy of $250 million.
Collectively, the founders will control 51.1% of the votes, but no single founder will hold significantly more shares or votes than the others.
Each will also receive one share of Class F stock, which carries supervoting rights.
